meta.source: AxonCore brandbook (elmundodejoella, 2025) + AxonCore Design System v1.0

tokens.name: brand-black
tokens.usage: Brandbook 03. Axon Black: the brand's ground. Canvas of the dark theme; ink of the light theme.

tokens.name: brand-graphite
tokens.usage: Brandbook 02. Graphite: secondary dark for print and supporting surfaces.

tokens.name: brand-mist
tokens.usage: Brandbook 01. Mist: light ground for print and light surfaces.

tokens.name: brand-white
tokens.usage: Brandbook 01b. Pure white: wordmark on black, light canvas.

tokens.name: brand-pulse
tokens.usage: Brandbook 04. Axon Pulse (magenta): first stop of the signal gradient; energy, live states.

tokens.name: brand-synapse
tokens.usage: Brandbook 05. Axon Synapse (violet): middle stop of the signal gradient; AI and intelligence.

tokens.name: brand-signal
tokens.usage: Brandbook 06. Axon Signal (blue): last stop of the signal gradient; interaction, data, primary accent.

tokens.name: ink-1000
tokens.usage: Brand black. Dark canvas; light-theme ink.

tokens.name: ink-950
tokens.usage: Dark theme surface-1 (sections, sidebars).

tokens.name: ink-900
tokens.usage: Brandbook matiz. Dark theme raised surfaces (cards).

tokens.name: ink-850
tokens.usage: Brandbook matiz. Dark theme overlays (menus, dialogs); dividers.

tokens.name: ink-800
tokens.usage: Dark theme default borders around cards and panels.

tokens.name: ink-750
tokens.usage: Brand graphite. Pressed neutral fills; light theme secondary text.

tokens.name: ink-700
tokens.usage: Brandbook matiz. Light theme secondary text (9.7:1 on mist).

tokens.name: ink-650
tokens.usage: Brandbook matiz. Hover on dark neutral fills.

tokens.name: ink-550
tokens.usage: Disabled text in the dark theme.

tokens.name: ink-500
tokens.usage: Control borders in the dark theme (3.9:1 on black); muted text in light (5.3:1 on white).

tokens.name: ink-400
tokens.usage: Muted text in the dark theme (6.2:1 on black); control borders in light (3.4:1 on white).

tokens.name: ink-350
tokens.usage: Secondary text in the dark theme (8.1:1 on black); disabled text in light.

tokens.name: ink-300
tokens.usage: Disabled fills and icons on light.

tokens.name: ink-200
tokens.usage: Brandbook matiz. Light theme borders; pressed state of light buttons.

tokens.name: ink-150
tokens.usage: Brandbook matiz. Light theme dividers and sunken fills.

tokens.name: ink-100
tokens.usage: Brand mist. Light surface-1; primary text in the dark theme (19.4:1 on black).

tokens.name: ink-0
tokens.usage: White. Light canvas and raised surfaces.

tokens.name: bg-canvas
tokens.usage: Page background. Brand black in dark; white in light.

tokens.name: bg-surface
tokens.usage: Sections, sidebars, alternating bands on the canvas.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: Cards and panels on canvas or surface (pair with border-default and shadow-1).

tokens.name: bg-overlay
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, dialogs (pair with shadow-3).

tokens.name: bg-sunken
tokens.usage: Inputs, code wells, track of switches. Always with border-strong.

tokens.name: bg-inverse
tokens.usage: Inverted blocks: the primary button, toasts, high-emphasis chips.

tokens.name: bg-hover
tokens.usage: Hover wash on neutral rows, ghost buttons and list items.

tokens.name: bg-selected
tokens.usage: Selected rows, active nav item, chosen option.

tokens.name: bg-glass
tokens.usage: Glass panels over imagery or gradient; always with blur-glass and border-subtle.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Body and headings on bg-canvas, bg-surface, bg-raised, bg-overlay (≥15:1 both themes).

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting copy and descriptions on every bg-* surface (≥6.4:1 dark, ≥9.7:1 light).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, meta, placeholders on every bg-* surface (≥4.9:1 dark, ≥4.9:1 light).

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels only (exempt from contrast minimums).

tokens.name: text-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on bg-inverse (19:1+).

tokens.name: text-link
tokens.usage: Inline links on canvas and surfaces (7.8:1 dark on black, 5.2:1 light on mist).

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers inside cards and tables; decorative only.

tokens.name: border-default
tokens.usage: Card, panel and table outlines; decorative only.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of interactive controls: inputs, checkboxes, outline buttons (≥3:1 on every surface).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Axon Signal blue: signal buttons, selected controls, focused data. Text on it is on-accent.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for accent controls.

tokens.name: accent-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed fill for accent controls.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent, accent-hover and accent-pressed (5.6:1, 7.8:1, 5.0:1).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px focus outline with 2px offset, on every surface (≥3:1).

tokens.name: action-primary
tokens.usage: Primary button fill: monochrome by design (white on dark, black on light).

tokens.name: action-primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover fill.

tokens.name: action-primary-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary button pressed fill.

tokens.name: on-action-primary
tokens.usage: Label on action-primary fills (≥10:1 in every state).

tokens.name: tone-pulse
tokens.usage: Pulse accent text and icons: live, real-time, energy highlights. On every bg-* surface (≥5.6:1 dark, ≥5.4:1 light).

tokens.name: tone-synapse
tokens.usage: Synapse accent text and icons: AI-generated content, models, intelligence (7.1:1 dark, 5.6:1 light).

tokens.name: tone-signal
tokens.usage: Signal accent text and icons: data, metrics, interactive hints.

tokens.name: tone-pulse-subtle
tokens.usage: Pulse tinted background for badges and callouts.

tokens.name: tone-synapse-subtle
tokens.usage: Synapse tinted background for AI badges and callouts.

tokens.name: tone-signal-subtle
tokens.usage: Signal tinted background for info badges and callouts.

tokens.name: status-success
tokens.usage: Success text/icon on canvas and surfaces (11:1 dark, 5.0:1 light). Always pair with an icon or word.

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: Warning text/icon on canvas and surfaces (11.6:1 dark, 5.4:1 light). Always pair with an icon or word.

tokens.name: status-danger
tokens.usage: Error text/icon on canvas and surfaces (7.4:1 dark, 5.1:1 light). Orange-red, kept apart from Pulse magenta.

tokens.name: status-info
tokens.usage: Informational text/icon.

tokens.name: status-success-subtle
tokens.usage: Success callout/badge background.

tokens.name: status-warning-subtle
tokens.usage: Warning callout/badge background.

tokens.name: status-danger-subtle
tokens.usage: Error callout/badge background.

styles.name: type-hero
styles.sample: IA Generativa para impulsar tu negocio
styles.usage: Agrandir Wide Light. One hero statement per page; ≤6 words. 56px under 768px.

styles.name: type-impact
styles.usage: Agrandir Grand Heavy. Campaign headlines and covers; ≤4 words. 44px under 768px.

styles.name: type-display
styles.usage: Agrandir Regular. Section openers and landing headlines. 40px under 768px.

styles.name: type-h1
styles.usage: Agrandir Regular. Page titles in product and docs. 32px under 768px.

styles.name: type-h3
styles.usage: Agrandir Text Bold. Card and panel titles.

styles.name: type-metric
styles.usage: Agrandir Tight. KPI figures and big numbers in dashboards and reports.

styles.name: type-quote
styles.usage: Agrandir Thin Italic. Pull quotes and editorial accents; never body copy.

styles.name: type-stamp
styles.usage: Agrandir Wide Black Italic, uppercase. Seals, campaign CTAs and stickers (brandbook: sellos).

styles.name: type-overline
styles.usage: Agrandir Narrow, uppercase. Kickers in campaigns and decks.

styles.name: type-lead
styles.sample: AxonCore connects data, models and teams in a single operating layer.
styles.usage: Geist. Intro paragraph under a display headline.

styles.name: type-body
styles.sample: Every integration is versioned, observable and reversible.

styles.name: type-body-sm
styles.usage: Geist. Dense UI copy, table cells, helper text.

styles.name: type-label
styles.usage: Geist Medium. Form labels, buttons, tabs, nav.

styles.name: type-eyebrow
styles.usage: Geist Mono Medium, uppercase. Section eyebrows above headings.

styles.name: type-code
styles.usage: Geist Mono. Code, CLI, IDs, API keys.

styles.name: type-data
styles.usage: Geist Mono Medium, tabular. Numbers in tables and live data.

spacing.note: 4px base grid. Layouts snap to 8px; 4px only inside components.

tokens.name: space-0
tokens.usage: Reset.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps, icon nudges.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Base unit. Icon-to-label gap in compact controls.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control inner padding (vertical); chip padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap; card padding on mobile; mobile gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Control inner padding (horizontal, lg).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; desktop grid gutter.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Panel padding; gap between related blocks.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between card groups.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Gap between sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Section padding (tablet).

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section padding (desktop).

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Hero padding; campaign whitespace.

radius.note: Soft but defined: 6–12px for UI, mirroring the rounded terminals of the isotype.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Badges, checkboxes, kbd, tags.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons (sm), inputs, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons (md/lg), tabs, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, popovers, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Feature cards, media, hero panels.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: App icon tiles and large campaign frames.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, avatars, switches, status dots.

shadow.note: Dark theme lifts with a top highlight plus deep shadow; light theme with soft shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Resting cards and raised panels.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Hovered cards, dropdowns, sticky headers.

tokens.name: shadow-3
tokens.usage: Dialogs, command palette, popovers.

tokens.name: shadow-signal
tokens.usage: Signal glow: AI-active elements and the focused hero input. Once per view.

gradient.note: The spectrum is a signal, not a wallpaper: ≤10% of any composition.

tokens.name: gradient-signal
tokens.usage: The Axon spectrum (Pulse → Synapse → Signal). Isotype, 1–2px signal lines, small data highlights. Never behind body text.

tokens.name: gradient-signal-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted spectrum for progress tracks and selected chart ranges.

tokens.name: gradient-core
tokens.usage: Dark depth for hero and cover backgrounds (dark theme).

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur for bg-glass panels.

tokens.name: blur-glass-strong
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur for overlays on busy imagery.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky headers.

tokens.name: z-dropdown
tokens.usage: Menus.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Scrims.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Dialogs.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts.

tokens.name: z-tooltip
tokens.usage: Tooltips.

tokens.name: duration-instant
tokens.usage: Press feedback, toggles.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, focus, color changes.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Menus, tabs, small layout shifts.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Dialogs, drawers, page sections.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Default: things entering and responding.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Things moving across the screen.

tokens.name: ease-in
tokens.usage: Things leaving.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Max content width.

tokens.name: container-wide
tokens.usage: Max width for dashboards and campaign layouts.

tokens.name: container-prose
tokens.usage: Max width for long-form reading.

tokens.name: grid-columns
tokens.usage: Desktop grid; 8 on tablet, 4 on mobile.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Height of small controls.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Height of default controls.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Height of large controls and hero inputs.
